entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie with VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Hi, Charlie. I... I'm calling about my VeloBand Pulse. I need to return it. I've been a loyal customer for years and I'm just so disappointed in myself right now.

I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied. I can see you're a VIP member with us, and we definitely want to help. To get started, can you tell me a bit more? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

Oh, no, it works fine. It's just... I changed my mind. It was a total impulse buy around the holidays, and to be honest, I just don't use it. I feel so guilty. I really needed this money for other things.
I completely understand. It happens to the best of us. Let me just pull up your order details and review our current return policy for you. Can you hold for just one moment?
Okay, thank you. I appreciate it.

Alright, thank you for waiting. I've just checked everything on my end. It looks like you received the VeloBand Pulse 37 days ago. Our policy allows for returns on items within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the window. We can absolutely get that return started for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's wonderful! Oh, thank you so much, Charlie! You have no idea what a relief that is. I was so worried.

Of course, I'm happy to help. It's our pleasure to take care of our VIP customers. I've just processed the return authorization. You'll receive an email within the next 15 minutes with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be issued.
That's fantastic. You've really made my day. Thank you again!
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you!
Great. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
